lesson.evidence: Crown graph K_{6,6}-M recognized as bipartite via BFS. Exact approach (2 colors) matched greedy best (2 colors) across 12 orderings. One greedy trial used 3 colors, showing ordering sensitivity. Local search from random 3-color initialization converged to 2 colors in 5 of 12 seeds. The missing p_i-q_i edges create independent sets enabling optimal 2-coloring.
lesson.statement: Crown graphs (complete bipartite minus perfect matching) have chromatic number 2; BFS bipartite detection guarantees optimality while greedy depends on node ordering.

summary: Greedy: 2 colors best, 3 colors worst (12 trials)
Local search: 2 colors best from 3-color starts (12 seeds)
All constraints satisfied: 12 nodes, 30 edges, no violations
